lsystems.name: L-Systems: Rules Grow Structure
lsystems.truth: A sentence can become a forest. Grammar is generative.
lsystems.qfep_connection: L-systems sit at the edge between deterministic rules (F) and emergent complexity (E). Simple rewriting rules produce infinite variation. The lambda parameter is iteration count — each generation pushes further toward the edge.
lsystems.description: From a single axiom, a tree grows. L-systems are string rewriting rules that generate branching structures — trees, cities, space-filling curves. Start in the grammar lab, watch growth unfold, formalize the rules, build cities, compete for space, and finally watch the world come alive.
